source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the divisions of the PNS (PDF 42-43).

blocks.text: PNS sensory raaste banata hai, yaani cranial aur spinal nerves ke sensory neurons jo receptors ko CNS se jorte hain, aur motor raaste, yaani motor neurons jo CNS ko effectors se jorte hain. Motor raaste do nizam banate hain.

items: Somatic nervous system: spinal aur cranial nerves ke woh motor neurons jo skeletal muscles chalate hain. Yeh iradi hai, is liye skeletal muscles marzi se hilte hain, agarche reflex actions mein yeh shaoori qaboo ke baghair kaam karta hai.

Autonomic nervous system: woh motor neurons jo smooth muscles aur glands chalate hain. Yeh ghair iradi hai aur saans, dil ki dharkan aur hazme jaisi andaruni halaton ko qaboo karta hai. Is ke do hisse hain.

Sympathetic nervous system: jismani ya jazbati dabao mein jism ko tayyar karta hai. Is ke motor neurons spinal cord ke thoracic aur lumbar hisson se shuru ho kar andaruni aaza tak jate hain; jab yeh sargarm ho to jism lado ya bhago ke liye tayyar hota hai: dil tez aur zor se dharakta, khoon mein glucose barhta, khoon muscles aur dil ki taraf morha jata, aur bronchioles phailti hain.

Parasympathetic nervous system: khatra ya dabao guzar jane par sympathetic rad-e-amal ka ulat karta hai. Is ke motor neurons dimagh aur spinal cord ke sacral hisse se shuru hote, kai vagus (daswin cranial) nerve mein hote hain; yeh aaza ko wapas naarmal karta hai: dil aahista hota, dil aur skeletal muscles ko khoon kam jata, aur hazme ke aaza zyada sargarm hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Imtihan se pehle dil tez dharakta aur munh khushk hai. Kaunsa hissa sargarm hai, aur munh khushk kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Sympathetic hissa: yeh dil tez karta aur laab ke glands ka ifraz kam karta hai.

items: Somatic: iradi, skeletal muscles. Autonomic: ghair iradi, smooth muscle aur glands.
Sympathetic (thoracic aur lumbar): lado ya bhago. Parasympathetic (dimagh aur sacral, vagus nerve): wapas naarmal.
